title: Hollow and Wolf
author: Orsen Thackeray
blurb: Mirabel Marchetti, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
